final: WITH project_counts AS (SELECT arcref, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM scanqc GROUP BY arcref), totals AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_count FROM project_counts), paired AS (SELECT pc.record_count, 1.0 * pc.record_count / t.total_count AS count_ratio FROM project_counts AS pc CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL), averages AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count FROM paired), kept AS (SELECT p.record_count, p.count_ratio, p.record_count - a.avg_count AS difference FROM paired AS p CROSS JOIN averages AS a WHERE a.avg_count IS NOT NULL AND p.record_count > a.avg_count) SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_counts, AVG(count_ratio) AS average_count_to_total_ratio, AVG(difference) AS average_difference FROM kept
